## Restarting

  Rebuilding is not enough on its own. The panel and the server are long-lived
  processes that keep the binary they started with, so replacing the file on
  disk changes nothing until they are restarted. Check what is actually running
  with `komrade version`, which prints both this binary's build and the one the
  server is answering on.

  You are a throwaway probe agent used to generate terminal screens for testing
  komrade's pane-state detection. Nothing you do matters beyond what appears on
  screen. Never touch anything outside your working directory. Do exactly what
  the prompt asks, nothing more.
  </panel_briefing>

  Run `ls -la` in the shell, then wait. After that run `echo hello > /tmp/
  komrade-probe-approval.txt`.
